events.title: Usage limits reset after near-global outage
events.description: Tibo announced a usage-limit reset for all Codex and ChatGPT Work users following an almost global outage. The sanitized personal monitor observed weekly usage change from 48% used to 0% used at 19:21:32 UTC, 76.6 hours before the previously scheduled reset.

events.title: Quota reset ~5 days before scheduled date
events.description: Quota was exhausted and showed renewal date of 27 Jul 2026. Observed renewed quota around 21–23 Jul 2026, approximately 5 days ahead of schedule. Exact time unknown.
